session.failedBody: Try opening Hoard again in a moment.

readOnly.title: Hoard is read-only
readOnly.body: Hoard's records are kept as they are. You can read and export them.

stock.title: Stock
stock.emptyBody: Your materials and products will be here: how much you hold of each, where it's kept and when to order more.

production.title: Production
production.emptyBody: Your production runs will be here: what you make, from which recipe, and the lots each run produces.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Reports on your stock and production will be here: what your stock is worth, what to reorder and what you made.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyBody: Hoard's settings for the whole community will be here: units of measure, categories, price tiers and store connections.
